findings.finding: Conditions that enhance expectancies for future performance contribute to motor performance and learning by strengthening goal-action coupling.
findings.quote: These include research on (a) conditions that enhance expectancies for future performance

findings.finding: Expected success helps consolidate memories and propels the cognitive and motor systems forward.
findings.quote: Expected success presumably breeds further success and helps consolidate memories.

findings.finding: Groups experiencing higher success rates and enhanced expectancies can make more hits and achieve heightened outcome expectancies.
findings.quote: As predicted, the Large-target group made more hits and had heightened outcome expectancies compared to the Small-target group.

principle: Enhancing learner expectancies for successful performance and providing early positive experiences help build motivation and support motor learning.
for_the_teacher: Design early exercises to ensure learners achieve immediate successful outcomes to boost confidence and expectancy.
